title: ScriptProps
summary: An optional content-security-policy nonce for document scripts.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Contains nonce?: string. Scripts applies it to the inline bootstrap, JSON hydration payload, and browser module entry script.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Generate and manage CSP nonces in the application’s server integration. ScrollRestoration accepts this shape for compatibility but emits no script and currently does not use nonce.
